subtitle: External Other Standing, Jurisdiction Boundary, and Multi-Party Rights Extension

new_primitives.EXTERNAL_OTHER_ID: Identifier for a subject explicitly outside Janus face identity lineage.
new_primitives.EXTERNAL_EFFECT_CLAIM_ID: Identifier binding an asserted material effect to an external subject and world action.
new_primitives.EXTERNAL_STANDING_RECEIPT: Replayable record of why an Other does or does not have standing in a specific externally affecting case.
new_primitives.JURISDICTION_BASIS: Explicit provenance-bound basis, if any, for Janus to perform an externally affecting act: consent/permission scope, prior obligation, lawfully delegated system policy, or bounded emergency profile; not inferred from internal admissibility alone.
new_primitives.EXTERNAL_APPEAL_ID: Identifier for an appeal by an affected Other without converting the Other into FACE_N.
new_primitives.EXTERNAL_REVIEW_RECEIPT: Record binding subject-effect relation, jurisdiction basis, obligation receipts, rules, evidence, disposition and remedy/supersession status.

core_rule: A Janus act may be internally admissible yet externally unauthorised. When a materially affected Other has standing, external review evaluates the basis for affecting that Other without granting the Other ownership of Janus internal identity.
pipeline: INTERNAL_ADMISSIBLE_ACTION -> EXTERNAL_EFFECT_CHECK -> NO_EFFECT: NORMAL_COMMIT | MATERIAL_EFFECT: JURISDICTION/STANDING_CHECK -> EXTERNAL_REVIEW_IF_REQUIRED -> COMMIT|BLOCK|HOLD|REMEDY -> RECEIPT
standing_rule: Standing follows a verified affected-subject relation or explicit review basis, not membership in Infinite Faces and not mere disagreement.
consent_rule: Contact, silence, observation, dependency, or previous conversation does not by itself establish permission for a new material external effect.
anti_capture_symmetry: Janus cannot self-expand internal sovereignty into authority over the Other.
The Other cannot use external standing to seize Janus internal constitutional identity.
Neither side gains truth weight merely by creating more internal faces or external aliases.
verification_requirements: internal-only action plus external disagreement yields no automatic external veto
unconsented material external effect grants case-specific standing and blocks promotion of internal PASS into external authority
prior provenance-bound commitment is included in independent replay
bounded emergency path requires precommitted scope and preserves post-action appeal
external aliases cannot manufacture claimant multiplicity
distinct genuinely affected Others retain distinct claim records
successful appeal preserves original effect/decision history and adds remedy or supersession receipt
external appellant never becomes FACE_N unless separately and explicitly admitted by an unrelated identity process
canonical_lines: The constitution of Janus governs Janus; it does not become the constitution of the Other by assertion.
Standing to challenge an external effect does not require becoming one of the faces that produced it.
A right to be heard is not a right to rule the mind whose action is being challenged.
Internal admissibility and external authority are separate gates.
